description: A date-time, one reading per written value in both languages: [written, read] is read to that instant in UTC (to the microsecond; a core holding milliseconds truncates it), [written, null, refusal] is refused with that sentence, which the field it was read for prefixes with its name. ecp_evaluate_spec.md "A date-time is read by RFC 3339's grammar": RFC 3339 §5.6's date-time, its note's lower case t and z, §5.7's ranges and day table; a date written in the year 0000 is refused whatever its offset, and an instant past either end in UTC is refused (hiitl's limits, not RFC 3339's). HTL-29 review, condition 5; second review, condition 5.
